```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The data used in this code was downloaded from [A immunogenomic analysis of pancancer study from TCGA](https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/panimmune). Since most of these data have restricted access. We cannot share the data in this public GitHub repo. 

# Setup

## R library and data input

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)
library(stringr)

theme_set(theme_classic())
data_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA"

```

# Summarize TCR data

## Load TCR data
```{r}
mitcr = fread(file.path(data_dir, "mitcr_sampleStatistics_20160714.tsv"))
tcga  = fread(file.path(data_dir, "TCGA_mitcr_cdr3_result_161008.tsv"))

dim(mitcr)
mitcr[1:3,]

summary(mitcr$totTCR_reads)
summary(mitcr$numClones)

table(mitcr$totTCR_reads == 0, mitcr$numClones == 0)

dim(tcga)
tcga[1:3,]
length(unique(tcga$AliquotBarcode))
```

## Check sample type 

```{r}
t1 = table(tcga$SampleTypeLetterCode)
length(t1)
sort(t1, decreasing=TRUE)[1:10]

tcga[SampleTypeLetterCode == "476fc4ce-6af7-42af-8cc0-c080f2739037",][1:2,]
tcga[SampleTypeLetterCode == "TAP",][1:2,]

sample_type_str = c("NT", "TAM", "TAP", "TM", "TP", "TR")
SampleTypeLetterCode = tcga$SampleTypeLetterCode
SampleTypeLetterCode[! SampleTypeLetterCode %in% sample_type_str] = "others"

sample_type = substr(tcga$AliquotBarcode, 14, 15)
table(sample_type, SampleTypeLetterCode)

tumor_sample_type = c("TAM", "TAP", "TM", "TP", "TR")
validtcga = subset(tcga, SampleTypeLetterCode %in% tumor_sample_type) 
dim(validtcga)
```

## Extract TCR data

Make sure the lengths of all the TCRs are between 5-24. Filter out TCR with "~" or "*".

```{r}
TCR = validtcga[,c("AliquotBarcode", "vAllele", "aaSeq", "chain", "abundance")]
dim(TCR)
TCR[1:2,]

table(grepl("~", TCR$aaSeq), grepl("\\*", TCR$aaSeq))

TCR_filtered = TCR[!grepl("~|\\*", TCR$aaSeq), ]
dim(TCR_filtered)
TCR_filtered[1:2,]

TCR_filtered$aaLen = nchar(TCR_filtered$aaSeq)
table(TCR_filtered$aaLen)

table(TCR_filtered$aaLen)
sum(TCR_filtered$aaLen >=8 & TCR_filtered$aaLen <= 18)/nrow(TCR_filtered)
```

## Consolidate TCR data

Here we want to define TCR based on CDR3 (or aaseq) only. If a TCR is defined based on both aaSeq and v-gene, then an aaSeq may appear multiple times in a sample.  We group by AliquotBarcode and summarize the frequency of aaSeq.

```{r}
nV = str_count(TCR_filtered$vAllele, fixed(", "))
table(nV == 0)/length(nV)
table(nV == 1)/length(nV)
table(nV > 1)/length(nV)
table(nV > 2)/length(nV)
table(nV > 5)/length(nV)

TCR_uniq = aggregate(abundance ~ AliquotBarcode + aaSeq + chain, 
                      TCR_filtered, sum)
TCR_uniq$Participant = substr(TCR_uniq$AliquotBarcode, 1, 12)

dim(TCR_uniq)
TCR_uniq[1:2,]

rm(TCR_filtered)

nrow(unique(TCR_uniq[,c("AliquotBarcode", "aaSeq", "chain")]))
table(TCR_uniq$abundance == 1)
summary(TCR_uniq$abundance[TCR_uniq$abundance > 1])

TCR_uniq[,c("AliquotBarcode", "Participant")] %>% unique %>% 
  reframe(table(table(Participant)))
```


# Summarize RNA-seq data

## Load RNA-seq data

```{r}
rna_file = "EBPlusPlusAdjustPANCAN_IlluminaHiSeq_RNASeqV2.geneExp.tsv"
rna = fread(file.path(data_dir, rna_file))

dim(rna)
rna[1:2,1:5]

rna_gene = data.frame(gene_id = rna$gene_id)
rna[,gene_id := NULL]

rna_sample = data.frame(AliquotBarcode = names(rna))
rna_sample$sample_type = substr(rna_sample$AliquotBarcode, 14, 15)
rna_sample$participant = substr(rna_sample$AliquotBarcode, 1, 12)

dim(rna_sample)
rna_sample[1:2,]

ts = table(rna_sample$participant)
table(ts)
rna_sample[rna_sample$participant == names(ts)[ts==3][1],]
```

## Calculate read-depth

```{r}
rna_sample$read_depth = colSums(rna, na.rm = TRUE)
summary(rna_sample$read_depth/1e6)

ggplot(data = rna_sample, aes(x = read_depth/1e6)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue") +
  labs(x = "Read-depth (millions)", y = "Frequency", 
       title = "TCGA RNA-seq data")
```

# Compare TCR and RNA-seq data

## get the total number of TCRs for each patient

```{r}
length(unique(TCR_uniq$"AliquotBarcode"))
TCR_sample = aggregate(abundance ~ AliquotBarcode, data = TCR_uniq, sum)
dim(TCR_sample)
head(TCR_sample)

summary(TCR_sample$abundance)
table(TCR_sample$abundance==1)
table(TCR_sample$abundance==2)

TCR_sample[grep("TCGA-A6-2677", TCR_sample$AliquotBarcode),]

ggplot(data = TCR_sample, aes(x = log10(abundance))) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue") +
  labs(x = "log10(TCR abundance)", y = "Frequency", 
       title = "TCGA TCR data")
```

## Compare TCR abundance and RNA-seq read-depth

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
table(TCR_sample$AliquotBarcode %in% rna_sample$AliquotBarcode)
TCR_rna = merge(TCR_sample, rna_sample, by = "AliquotBarcode")
dim(TCR_rna)
head(TCR_rna)

cor(TCR_rna$abundance, TCR_rna$read_depth)
cor(log10(TCR_rna$abundance), log10(TCR_rna$read_depth))

ggplot(data = TCR_rna, mapping = aes(x = log10(read_depth), 
                                     y = log10(abundance))) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()
```


# Read in tumor purity and cell type composition

```{r}
purity_file  = "TCGA_mastercalls.abs_tables_JSedit.fixed.txt"
ct_prop_file = "TCGA.Kallisto.fullIDs.cibersort.relative.tsv"

purity   = fread(file.path(data_dir, purity_file))
relative = fread(file.path(data_dir, ct_prop_file))

dim(purity)
purity[1:2,]

setnames(purity, "sample", "barcode")
setnames(purity, "array", "sample")
dim(purity)
purity[1:2,]

dim(relative)
relative[1:2,]

setnames(relative, "SampleID", "barcode")
relative$barcode = gsub("\\.", "-", relative$barcode)
dim(relative)
relative[1:2,]

summary(rowSums(relative[,3:24]))
```


## Check sample types and filter out tumor samples

```{r}
table(substr(relative$barcode, 14, 15))
sort(table(substr(purity$sample, 14, 15)))

tumor_sample_types = paste0("0", 1:9)
relative = relative[substr(barcode, 14, 15) %in% tumor_sample_types,]
purity   = purity[substr(barcode, 14, 15) %in% tumor_sample_types,]

table(substr(relative$barcode, 14, 15))
table(substr(purity$barcode, 14, 15))
```


## Calculate proportion of T cells

```{r}
t_cells = c("T.cells.CD8", "T.cells.CD4.naive", "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", 
            "T.cells.CD4.memory.activated", "T.cells.follicular.helper", 
            "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.")

relative$T_cell_prop = rowSums(relative[, ..t_cells])

T_cell_info = relative[,c("barcode", "T_cell_prop")]
T_cell_info$sample = substr(T_cell_info$barcode, 1, 15)

dim(T_cell_info)
T_cell_info[1:2,]
```


## Adjust the proportion of T cells by tumor purity

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
dim(purity)
purity[1:2,]
summary(purity$purity)
purity = purity[!is.na(purity),]

table(table(purity$sample))
table(table(T_cell_info$sample))

table(T_cell_info$sample %in% purity$sample)
T_cell_info = merge(T_cell_info, purity, by="sample", 
                    suffixes = c("", "_DNA"))
T_cell_info[,T_cell_prop_adjusted := T_cell_prop * (1 - purity)]

dim(T_cell_info)
T_cell_info[1:2,]

ggplot(data = T_cell_info, aes(x = purity)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.02), 
                 fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue")

ggplot(data = T_cell_info, aes(x = T_cell_prop_adjusted)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.02), 
                 fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue")
```

## Check the association between TCR abundance and T cell proportion

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
setnames(TCR_rna, "AliquotBarcode", "barcode")
TCR_rna_t_cell = merge(TCR_rna, T_cell_info, by = "barcode")
dim(TCR_rna_t_cell)
TCR_rna_t_cell[1:2,]

summary(TCR_rna_t_cell$T_cell_prop_adjusted)
summary(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance)
cor(TCR_rna_t_cell$T_cell_prop_adjusted, TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance, use="pair")
cor(TCR_rna_t_cell$T_cell_prop_adjusted, log10(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance), 
    use="pair")

cor(TCR_rna_t_cell$T_cell_prop_adjusted*TCR_rna_t_cell$read_depth, 
    log10(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance), use="pair")

ggplot(data = TCR_rna_t_cell, mapping = aes(x = T_cell_prop_adjusted, 
                                     y = log10(abundance))) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()
```


## Check whether we should filter out the samples with high tumor purity

It looks like we do not need to filter by tumor purity. 

```{r}
table(TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.9)
tapply(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance, TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.9, summary)

table(TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.95)
tapply(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance, TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.95, summary)

table(TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.98)
tapply(TCR_rna_t_cell$abundance, TCR_rna_t_cell$purity <= 0.98, summary)

```

# Prepare TCR data for association analysis

## Aggregate the data per participant

```{r}
TCR_sample = data.table(TCR_sample)
setnames(TCR_sample, "AliquotBarcode", "barcode")

TCR_sample[, sample_type := substr(barcode, 14, 15)]
TCR_sample[, participant := substr(barcode, 1, 12)]

table(table(TCR_sample$participant))
table(is.na(TCR_sample$abundance))

dim(TCR_sample)
TCR_sample[1:2,]

TCR_sample = merge(TCR_sample, TCR_rna_t_cell[,c("barcode", "purity", 
                                                 "T_cell_prop_adjusted")], 
                   all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
dim(TCR_sample)
TCR_sample[1:2,]

mean_na <- function(x){mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)}

sample_info = TCR_sample[, .(abundance = sum(abundance), 
                             purity = mean_na(purity), 
                             T_cell_prop = mean_na(T_cell_prop_adjusted)), 
                         by = participant]
dim(sample_info)
sample_info[1:2,]

summary(sample_info$abundance)
summary(sample_info$purity)
summary(sample_info$T_cell_prop)

TCR_participant = aggregate(abundance ~ Participant + aaSeq + chain, 
                             TCR_uniq, sum)

dim(TCR_uniq)
dim(TCR_participant)
TCR_participant[1:2,]

sample_info[sample_info$participant == "TCGA-EE-A2GT"]
sum(TCR_participant$abundance[TCR_participant$Participant == "TCGA-EE-A2GT"])

nrow(unique(TCR_participant[,c("Participant", "aaSeq", "chain")]))

table(TCR_uniq$chain, useNA='ifany')
```

## Separate TCRs by chain type, alpha chain

```{r}
TCR_alpha = TCR_participant[TCR_participant$chain == "alpha", ]
dim(TCR_alpha)
head(TCR_alpha)

table(nchar(TCR_alpha$aaSeq))
length(unique(TCR_alpha$Participant))
summary(as.numeric(table(TCR_alpha$Participant)))

alpha_freq = table(TCR_alpha$aaSeq)

length(alpha_freq)
table(alpha_freq == 1)/length(alpha_freq)
table(alpha_freq >= 5)
table(alpha_freq >= 10)

alpha2kp = names(alpha_freq)[alpha_freq >= 5]
length(alpha2kp)
TCR_alpha = TCR_alpha[TCR_alpha$aaSeq %in% alpha2kp,]
dim(TCR_alpha)
head(TCR_alpha)
summary(as.numeric(table(TCR_alpha$aaSeq)))

nrow(unique(TCR_alpha[,c("Participant", "aaSeq")]))

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/TCR_alpha_5.tsv")

fwrite(TCR_alpha, file=fnm, sep="\t")
```

## Separate TCRs by chain type, beta chain

```{r}
TCR_beta = TCR_participant[TCR_participant$chain == "beta", ]
dim(TCR_beta)
head(TCR_beta)

table(nchar(TCR_beta$aaSeq))
length(unique(TCR_beta$Participant))
summary(as.numeric(table(TCR_beta$Participant)))

beta_freq = table(TCR_beta$aaSeq)

length(beta_freq)
table(beta_freq == 1)/length(beta_freq)
table(beta_freq >= 5)
table(beta_freq >= 10)

beta2kp = names(beta_freq)[beta_freq >= 5]
length(beta2kp)
TCR_beta = TCR_beta[TCR_beta$aaSeq %in% beta2kp,]
dim(TCR_beta)
head(TCR_beta)
summary(as.numeric(table(TCR_beta$aaSeq)))

nrow(unique(TCR_beta[,c("Participant", "aaSeq")]))

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/TCR_beta_5.tsv")

fwrite(TCR_beta, file=fnm, sep="\t")
```

# Summarize somatic mutation data

## Read in somatic mutation data

Keep those mutations that satisfy the following two criteria.

* filters is "PASS", "wga", or "native_wga_mix"
* NCALLERS > 1

```{r}
mutation_file = "mc3.v0.2.8.CONTROLLED.maf.gz"
test1 = fread(file.path(data_dir, mutation_file), nrows=5)
dim(test1)
names(test1)
test1[1,]

mut_dat = fread(file.path(data_dir, mutation_file), 
                select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "NCBI_Build", "Chromosome", 
                           "Start_Position", "End_Position", 
                           "Strand", "Reference_Allele", 
                           "Tumor_Seq_Allele1", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", 
                           "Variant_Classification", 
                           "Variant_Type", "Gene", "Consequence", 
                           "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "HGVSc", "HGVSp", 
                           "HGVSp_Short", "t_depth", "t_ref_count", 
                           "t_alt_count", "FILTER", "CENTERS", "NCALLERS"))
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

filters = c("PASS", "wga", "native_wga_mix")

t1 = table(mut_dat$FILTER)
sort(t1, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
t1[names(t1) %in% filters]

table(mut_dat$NCALLERS)
table(mut_dat$FILTER %in% filters, mut_dat$NCALLERS > 1)

mut_dat = mut_dat[FILTER %in% filters,]
dim(mut_dat)
table(mut_dat$FILTER, mut_dat$NCALLERS > 1)

mut_dat = mut_dat[NCALLERS > 1,]
dim(mut_dat)

table(mut_dat$Reference_Allele == mut_dat$Tumor_Seq_Allele1)
table(mut_dat$Reference_Allele == mut_dat$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)

table(mut_dat$t_depth -  mut_dat$t_ref_count - mut_dat$t_alt_count)

sort(table(mut_dat$Variant_Type))
# ONP: Oncogenic Non-Passenger
# TNP: Truncal Non-Passenger
sort(table(mut_dat$Variant_Classification[mut_dat$Variant_Type=="ONP"]))
sort(table(mut_dat$Variant_Classification[mut_dat$Variant_Type=="TNP"]))

sort(table(mut_dat$Variant_Classification))
sort(table(mut_dat$Consequence))

table(mut_dat$Consequence[mut_dat$Variant_Classification=="5'Flank"])
table(mut_dat$Consequence[mut_dat$Variant_Classification=="RNA"])
table(mut_dat$Consequence[mut_dat$Variant_Classification=="Nonstop_Mutation"])

table(mut_dat$Variant_Classification[mut_dat$Consequence=="stop_gained"])
```

## Filter out non-silent mutations

```{r}
mut_dat[,participant := substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)]
mut_dat[,pos:=paste(Chromosome, Start_Position, sep=":")]
mut_dat[,key:=paste(pos, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2, sep=":")]

dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

mut_dat_uniq = unique(mut_dat[,c("Hugo_Symbol", "participant", "key")])
dim(mut_dat_uniq)
mut_dat_uniq[1:2,]

stopifnot(nrow(mut_dat) == nrow(mut_dat_uniq))

sample_info_mut = data.frame(table(mut_dat_uniq$participant))
names(sample_info_mut) = c("participant", "n_mut")
dim(sample_info_mut)
sample_info_mut[1:2,]

cat2kp = c("Nonstop_Mutation", "Translation_Start_Site", "In_Frame_Ins", 
           "In_Frame_Del", "Splice_Site", "Nonsense_Mutation", 
           "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Missense_Mutation")

mut_dat = mut_dat[Variant_Classification %in% cat2kp,]
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

mut_dat_uniq = unique(mut_dat[,c("Hugo_Symbol", "participant", "key")])
dim(mut_dat_uniq)
mut_dat_uniq[1:2,]
stopifnot(nrow(mut_dat) == nrow(mut_dat_uniq))

sample_info_mut2 = data.frame(table(mut_dat_uniq$participant))
names(sample_info_mut2) = c("participant", "n_non_silent_mut")
dim(sample_info_mut2)
sample_info_mut2[1:2,]

sample_info_mut = merge(sample_info_mut, sample_info_mut2, all.x=TRUE)
dim(sample_info_mut)
sample_info_mut[1:2,]

is_na = is.na(sample_info_mut$n_non_silent_mut)
table(is_na)
sample_info_mut$n_non_silent_mut[which(is_na)] = 0

summary(sample_info_mut$n_mut)
summary(sample_info_mut$n_non_silent_mut)

mut_info = unique(mut_dat[,.(Hugo_Symbol, Variant_Classification, 
                              HGVSc, HGVSp, HGVSp_Short, key)])
mut_info = mut_info[order(Hugo_Symbol, key)]
dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:2,]

mut_freq <- mut_dat_uniq[, .N, by = .(key)]
setnames(mut_freq, "N", "Freq")
dim(mut_freq)
mut_freq[1:2,]

stopifnot(setequal(mut_freq$key, mut_info$key))
mut_info = merge(mut_info, mut_freq)
dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:2,]

mut_info[Hugo_Symbol == "SF3B1",][order(-Freq)]

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/mutation_info.tsv")
fwrite(mut_info, fnm, sep = "\t")
```


## Add cancer type information

Some patients can have multiple types of cancer and we exclude them here. 

```{r}
sq = fread(file.path(data_dir, "merged_sample_quality_annotations.tsv"))
dim(sq)
sq[1:2,]

names(sq)[c(1,3)] = c("participant", "cancer_type")
sq = unique(sq[,c("participant", "cancer_type")])
dim(sq)
sq[1:2,]

t1 = table(sq$participant)
table(t1)
t1[t1> 1]

sq[sq$participant == "TCGA-07-0227",]
sq[sq$participant == "TCGA-44-6146",]

sq = sq[sq$participant %in% names(t1)[t1==1],]

table(sample_info_mut$participant %in% sq$participant)
sample_info_mut = merge(sample_info_mut, sq)
dim(sample_info_mut)
sample_info_mut[1:2,]

dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat = mut_dat[participant %in% sample_info_mut$participant, ]
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,]

mut_dat_uniq = unique(mut_dat[,c("Hugo_Symbol", "participant", "key")])
dim(mut_dat_uniq)
mut_dat_uniq[1:2,]

stopifnot(nrow(mut_dat) == nrow(mut_dat_uniq))
```

## Select unique combination of gene and participant

```{r}
table(is.na(mut_dat$Hugo_Symbol))
table(mut_dat$Hugo_Symbol == "")
length(unique(mut_dat$Hugo_Symbol))

mut_dat_gene = unique(mut_dat_uniq[,c("participant", "Hugo_Symbol")])
dim(mut_dat_gene)
mut_dat_gene[1:2,]

t3 = table(mut_dat_gene$Hugo_Symbol)
summary(as.numeric(t3))
sort(t3, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]

t2 = table(mut_dat_uniq$key)
table(t2 == 1)
table(t2 == 2)
table(t2 >= 5)

summary(as.numeric(t2))

mut_dat_uniq = mut_dat_uniq[key %in% names(t2)[t2 >= 5],]
mut_dat_uniq[,key := paste(Hugo_Symbol, key, sep=":")]
mut_dat_uniq[,Hugo_Symbol := NULL]
dim(mut_dat_uniq)
mut_dat_uniq[1:2,]

t2 = table(mut_dat_uniq$key)
summary(as.numeric(t2))
sort(t2, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/mutation_gene_all.tsv")
fwrite(mut_dat_gene, file=fnm, sep="\t")

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/mutation_freq_geq_5.tsv")
fwrite(mut_dat_uniq, file=fnm, sep="\t")
```


## Save sample information

```{r}
dim(sample_info)
sample_info[1:2,]

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/sample_info.tsv")
fwrite(sample_info, file=fnm, sep="\t")

dim(sample_info_mut)
sample_info_mut[1:2,]

fnm = file.path(data_dir, "_processed_data/sample_info_mutations.tsv")

```

## Check mutation frequency of genes

```{r}
df1 = data.frame(table(mut_dat_gene$Hugo_Symbol))
names(df1) = c("Gene", "Freq")
n_patient = length(unique(mut_dat_gene$participant))
n_patient
df1$percent_mutation = df1$Freq / n_patient
df1 = df1[order(df1$percent_mutation, decreasing = TRUE),]
dim(df1)
df1[1:20,,drop=FALSE]

df1$percent_mutation[df1$percent_mutation > 0.16] = 0.16
ggplot(data = df1, aes(x = percent_mutation)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0, 0.16, by=0.005), 
                 fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue")

```
 
## Check mutation frequency of individual mutations

```{r}
df1 = data.frame(table(mut_dat_uniq$key))
names(df1) = c("Mutation", "Freq")
df1$percent_mutation = df1$Freq / n_patient
df1 = df1[order(df1$percent_mutation, decreasing = TRUE),]
dim(df1)
df1[1:20,,drop=FALSE]

summary(df1$percent_mutation)
summary(log10(df1$percent_mutation))
```
